title: Bharata enters Ayodhya city
introduction: Bharata enters Ayodhya city, which appears to him gloomy and asks his charioteer why the city is looking luster-less. Thus speaking in many ways, Bharata enters his father's house which exhibits a vacant look and feels distressed.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमाद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्दशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus completes 114th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
स्निग्ध गम्भीर घोषेण स्यन्दनेन उपयान् प्रभुः |
अयोध्याम् भरतः क्षिप्रम् प्रविवेश महा यशाः
verses.iast:
snigdha gambhīra ghoṣeṇa syandanena upayān prabhuḥ |
ayodhyām bharataḥ kṣipram praviveśa mahā yaśāḥ
verses.translation: The highly illustrious Lord, Bharata riding on a chariot emanating a gentle and deep sound entered soon the city of Ayodhya.

glosses.meaning: producing a gentle and deep sound

verses.devanagari:
बिडाल उलूक चरिताम् आलीन नर वारणाम् |
तिमिर अभ्याहताम् कालीम् अप्रकाशाम् निशाम् इव
verses.iast:
biḍāla ulūka caritām ālīna nara vāraṇām |
timira abhyāhatām kālīm aprakāśām niśām iva
verses.translation: He entered the city, frequented by cats and owls, abiding with crouched men and elephants and looking like a night enveloped by gloom, indistinctness and darkness.

glosses.meaning: (He entered the city) frequented by cats and owls
abiding with crouched men and elephants

verses.devanagari:
राहु शत्रोः प्रियाम् पत्नीम् श्रिया प्रज्वलित प्रभाम् |
ग्रहेण अभ्युत्थितेन एकाम् रोहिणीम् इव पीडिताम्
verses.iast:
rāhu śatroḥ priyām patnīm śriyā prajvalita prabhām |
graheṇa abhyutthitena ekām rohiṇīm iva pīḍitām
verses.translation: Ayodhya looked like the planet Rohini, the beloved consort of the moon-god (treated as the enemy by the demon Rahu), tormented by planet Rahu* in the ascendant though ordinarily invested with an exceedingly bright splendour by virtue of her glory.
notes: *The demon presiding over a planet of the same name figuring in Indian astronomy and identified by modern astronoy with the shadow of the earth cast on the orb of the moon during what is known as a lunar eclipse.

glosses.meaning: of the moon-god (treated as the enemy by the demon Rahu)
though invested with an exceedingly bright splendour

verses.devanagari:
अल्प उष्ण क्षुब्ध सलिलाम् घर्म उत्तप्त विहम्गमाम् |
लीन मीन झष ग्राहाम् कृशाम् गिरि नदीम् इव
verses.iast:
alpa uṣṇa kṣubdha salilām gharma uttapta vihamgamām |
līna mīna jhaṣa grāhām kṛśām giri nadīm iva
verses.translation: Ayodhya further looked emaciated like a mountain stream, whose scanty waters had become hot and agitated, birds living in which were scorched by the sun, and whose fish, small and big and alligators had perished.

glosses.meaning: whose scanty waters had become hot and agitated
birds living in which were scorched by the sun

verses.devanagari:
विधूमाम् इव हेम आभाम् अध्वर अग्नि समुत्थिताम् |
हविर् अभ्युक्षिताम् पश्चात् शिखाम् विप्रलयम् गताम्
verses.iast:
vidhūmām iva hema ābhām adhvara agni samutthitām |
havir abhyukṣitām paścāt śikhām vipralayam gatām
verses.translation: Ayodhya looked like a flame of sacrificial fire which when oblation is poured into it, rises like a golden cone without smoke and thereafter sinks into extinction (ash).

verses.devanagari:
विध्वस्त कवचाम् रुग्ण गज वाजि रथ ध्वजाम् |
हत प्रवीराम् आपन्नाम् चमूम् इव महा आहवे
verses.iast:
vidhvasta kavacām rugṇa gaja vāji ratha dhvajām |
hata pravīrām āpannām camūm iva mahā āhave
verses.translation: Ayodhya looked like an afflicted army, shattered of its armour in a major conflict, whose ensigns borne on horses, elephants and chariots had been torn, and its heroic warriors slain.

verses.devanagari:
सफेनाम् सस्वनाम् भूत्वा सागरस्य समुत्थिताम् |
प्रशान्त मारुत उद्धूताम् जल ऊर्मिम् इव निह्स्वनाम्
verses.iast:
saphenām sasvanām bhūtvā sāgarasya samutthitām |
praśānta māruta uddhūtām jala ūrmim iva nihsvanām
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared like the waves of the sea though tosses very high with foam and a roar, is rendered noiseless, being shaken up by a silent wind.

glosses.meaning: like the waves of the sea
being shaken up by a silent wind.

verses.devanagari:
त्यक्ताम् यज्न आयुधैः सर्वैर् अभिरूपैः च याजकैः |
सुत्या काले विनिर्वृत्ते वेदिम् गत रवाम् इव
verses.iast:
tyaktām yajna āyudhaiḥ sarvair abhirūpaiḥ ca yājakaiḥ |
sutyā kāle vinirvṛtte vedim gata ravām iva
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared like a sacred altar, which, when the period of offering oblations into fire has completely expired, has been cleared of all sacrificial implements and deserted of recitations by the learned priests.

verses.devanagari:
गोष्ठ मध्ये स्थिताम् आर्ताम् अचरन्तीम् नवम् तृणम् |
गो वृषेण परित्यक्ताम् गवाम् पत्नीम् इव उत्सुकाम्
verses.iast:
goṣṭha madhye sthitām ārtām acarantīm navam tṛṇam |
go vṛṣeṇa parityaktām gavām patnīm iva utsukām
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared like restless kine, deprived of the bull, who cease to graze in new pastures and stand in the cow-pen, dispirited.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभा करालैः सुस्निग्धैः प्रज्वलद्भिर् इव उत्तमैः |
वियुक्ताम् मणिभिर् जात्यैर् नवाम् मुक्ता आवलीम् इव
verses.iast:
prabhā karālaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ prajvaladbhir iva uttamaiḥ |
viyuktām maṇibhir jātyair navām muktā āvalīm iva
verses.translation: Ayodhya was resembling a new pearl-necklace, bereft of well- polished dazzling and excellent gems, rubies and the like, of genuine quality.

verses.devanagari:
सहसा चलिताम् स्थानान् महीम् पुण्य क्षयाद् गताम् |
सम्हृत द्युति विस्ताराम् ताराम् इव दिवः च्युताम्
verses.iast:
sahasā calitām sthānān mahīm puṇya kṣayād gatām |
samhṛta dyuti vistārām tārām iva divaḥ cyutām
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared like a meteor, which moved from its position with its virtue exhausted, soon dropped from the sky and fallen to earth, deprived of its splendour.

verses.devanagari:
पुष्प नद्धाम् वसन्त अन्ते मत्त भ्रमर शालिनीम् |
द्रुत दाव अग्नि विप्लुष्टाम् क्लान्ताम् वन लताम् इव
verses.iast:
puṣpa naddhām vasanta ante matta bhramara śālinīm |
druta dāva agni vipluṣṭām klāntām vana latām iva
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared like a flowering creeper laden with blossom in the spring-tide, frequented by a swarm of intoxicated bees, that is suddenly consumed by a forest fire and withering.

glosses.meaning: that is suddenly consumed by a forest fire

verses.devanagari:
सम्मूढ निगमाम् सर्वाम् सम्क्षिप्त विपण आपणाम् |
प्रग्च्छन्न शशि नक्षत्राम् द्याम् इव अम्बु धरैर् वृताम्
verses.iast:
sammūḍha nigamām sarvām samkṣipta vipaṇa āpaṇām |
pragcchanna śaśi nakṣatrām dyām iva ambu dharair vṛtām
verses.translation: With its senseless traffic paralyzed and with its fairs and markets closed, Ayodhya resembled like a firmament, covered with clouds, with the moon and stars obscured.

glosses.meaning: with the moon and the stars obscured

verses.devanagari:
क्षीण पान उत्तमैर् भिन्नैः शरावैर् अभिसम्वृताम् |
हत शौण्डाम् इव आकाशे पान भूमिम् असंस्कृताम्
verses.iast:
kṣīṇa pāna uttamair bhinnaiḥ śarāvair abhisamvṛtām |
hata śauṇḍām iva ākāśe pāna bhūmim asaṃskṛtām
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared splendourless, like a deserted and uncleaned tavern, with its vendor of spirituous liquors killed, the excellent wine expended, its drinking pots and glasses broken and the pieces stewn in disorder.

glosses.meaning: with its vendor of spirituous liquors killed

verses.devanagari:
वृक्ण भूमि तलाम् निम्नाम् वृक्ण पात्रैः समावृताम् |
उपयुक्त उदकाम् भग्नाम् प्रपाम् निपतिताम् इव
verses.iast:
vṛkṇa bhūmi talām nimnām vṛkṇa pātraiḥ samāvṛtām |
upayukta udakām bhagnām prapām nipatitām iva
verses.translation: Ayodhya resembled a cistern erected for storage and distribution of water, but now broken and collapsed with its platform riven and sunk, and covered with broken jars and earthen vessels, its water having been used up.

glosses.meaning: its jars and earthen vessels broken

verses.devanagari:
विपुलाम् वितताम् चैव युक्त पाशाम् तरस्विनाम् |
भूमौ बाणैर् विनिष्कृत्ताम् पतिताम् ज्याम् इव आयुधात्
verses.iast:
vipulām vitatām caiva yukta pāśām tarasvinām |
bhūmau bāṇair viniṣkṛttām patitām jyām iva āyudhāt
verses.translation: Ayodhya resembled a bow-string, which was large and bent, with suitable noose at both ends, but severed from the bow by the arrows of heroes and fallen to the ground.

glosses.meaning: with suitable noose at both ends

verses.devanagari:
सहसा युद्ध शौण्डेन हय आरोहेण वाहिताम् |
निहताम् प्रतिसैन्येन वडवामिव पातिताम्
verses.iast:
sahasā yuddha śauṇḍena haya āroheṇa vāhitām |
nihatām pratisainyena vaḍavāmiva pātitām
verses.translation: Ayodhya appeared like a mare, urged on suddenly by a horse-man, skilled in war-fare and fallen down when killed by the opposite army.

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्तु रथस्थः सन् श्रीमान् दशरथात्मजः |
वाहयन्तं रथश्रेष्ठं सारथिम् वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
bharatastu rathasthaḥ san śrīmān daśarathātmajaḥ |
vāhayantaṃ rathaśreṣṭhaṃ sārathim vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: Sitting in the chariot, the glorious Bharata, the son of Dasaratha, spoke the following words to the charioteer who was riding his excellent chariot:

verses.devanagari:
किम् नु खल्वद्य गम्बीरो मूर्चितो न निशम्यते |
यथापुरमयोध्यायाम् गीतवादित्रनिस्वनः
verses.iast:
kim nu khalvadya gambīro mūrcito na niśamyate |
yathāpuramayodhyāyām gītavāditranisvanaḥ
verses.translation: "How is it that the deep and intensified sound of vocal and instrumental music is not heard as before in Ayodhya today?"

glosses.meaning: sound of vocal and instrumental music

verses.devanagari:
वारुणीमदगन्धश्च माल्यगन्धश्च मूर्चितः |
धूपितागरुगन्धश्च न प्रवाति समन्ततः
verses.iast:
vāruṇīmadagandhaśca mālyagandhaśca mūrcitaḥ |
dhūpitāgarugandhaśca na pravāti samantataḥ
verses.translation: "The intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor or the fragrance of floral garlands or the aroma of sandal and aloe-wood fumes, which used to be spread once on all sides, are not being wafted."

glosses.meaning: the intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor
or the fragrance of floral garlands
or the aroma of aloe-wood fumes

verses.devanagari:
यानप्र वरघोषश्च स्निग्धश्च हयनिस्वनः |
प्रमत्तगजनादश्च महांश्च रथनिस्वनः
नेदानीम् श्रूयते पुर्यामस्याम् रामे विवासिते
verses.iast:
yānapra varaghoṣaśca snigdhaśca hayanisvanaḥ |
pramattagajanādaśca mahāṃśca rathanisvanaḥ
nedānīm śrūyate puryāmasyām rāme vivāsite
verses.translation: "O, Sumantra! I do not hear, as before, the sound of the horses, the sound of the intoxicating elephants and the clattering of the great chariots in this city now."

glosses.meaning: the sound of the excellent carriages
the sound of the intoxicating elephants
and the clattering of the great chariots

verses.devanagari:
चन्दनागारुगन्धांश्च महार्हश्च नवस्रजः
गते हि रामे तरुणाः संतप्ता नोपभुञ्जते |
verses.iast:
candanāgārugandhāṃśca mahārhaśca navasrajaḥ
gate hi rāme taruṇāḥ santaptā nopabhuJṇjate |
verses.translation: "Rama, having left Ayodhya, the distressful youth are not making use of the perfumes like sandal-wood, aloe wood as also the most admirable and fresh floral garlands."

glosses.meaning: the perfumes of sandal-wood and aloe-wood

verses.devanagari:
बहिर्यात्रां न गच्छन्ति चित्रमाअल्यधरा नराः
नोत्सवाः सम्प्रवर्तन्ते रामशोकार्दिते पुरे |
verses.iast:
bahiryātrāṃ na gacchanti citramāalyadharā narāḥ
notsavāḥ sampravartante rāmaśokārdite pure |
verses.translation: "In the city afflicted by Rama's desertion, people are not going out for pleasure-trips, wearing colourful garlands nor festivals are observed by them."

glosses.meaning: afflicted by the grief of Rama's desertion

verses.devanagari:
सह नूनम् मम भ्रात्रा पुरस्यास्य द्युतिर्गता
न हि राजत्ययोध्येयं सासारेवार्जुनी क्षपा |
verses.iast:
saha nūnam mama bhrātrā purasyāsya dyutirgatā
na hi rājatyayodhyeyaṃ sāsārevārjunī kṣapā |
verses.translation: "The lustre of Ayodhya has departed along with my brother. It is certain. This Ayodhya is not shining indeed, like a rainy night at the time of the waning moon."

glosses.meaning: at the time of the waning moon.

verses.devanagari:
कदा नु खलु मे भ्राता महोत्सव इवागतः
जनयिष्यत्ययोध्यायां हर्षम् ग्रीष्म इवाम्बुदः |
verses.iast:
kadā nu khalu me bhrātā mahotsava ivāgataḥ
janayiṣyatyayodhyāyāṃ harṣam grīṣma ivāmbudaḥ |
verses.translation: "When will my brother return, like a carnival, diffusing joy in Ayodhya, as do the autumnal rains?"

verses.devanagari:
तरुणैः चारु वेषैः च नरैर् उन्नत गामिभिः |
सम्पतद्भिर् अयोध्यायाम् न विभान्ति महा पथाः
verses.iast:
taruṇaiḥ cāru veṣaiḥ ca narair unnata gāmibhiḥ |
sampatadbhir ayodhyāyām na vibhānti mahā pathāḥ
verses.translation: "The highways in Ayodhya are not glittering with youthful people, richly attired, bearing themselves bravely and roaming about in groups."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् बहु विधम् जल्पन् विवेश वसतिम् पितुः |
तेन हीनाम् नर इन्द्रेण सिम्ह हीनाम् गुहाम् इव
verses.iast:
evam bahu vidham jalpan viveśa vasatim pituḥ |
tena hīnām nara indreṇa simha hīnām guhām iva
verses.translation: Thus speaking in many ways, Bharata entered his father's house, bereft of that emperor and which resembled a cave bereft of a lion.

verses.devanagari:
तदा तदन्तःपुरमुज्घितप्रभम् |
सुरैरिवोत्सृष्टमभास्करम् दिनम् |
निरीक्ष्य सर्वम् तु विविक्तमात्मवान् |
मुमोच बाष्पं भरतः सुदुःखितः
verses.iast:
tadā tadantḥpuramujghitaprabham |
surairivotsṛṣṭamabhāskaram dinam |
nirīkṣya sarvam tu viviktamātmavān |
mumoca bāṣpaṃ bharataḥ suduḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: Bharata, though a composed man himself, shed tears by seeing that entire empty gynaecium, looking like a day without the sun with its relinquished radiance.
